evals.name: author-new-week-approval-gate
evals.prompt: 帮我写第 38 周（2026-09-14 到 2026-09-20）的周报，领导版和个人版都要。模板用官方的技术研发模板。写好先给我看全文，我确认了再保存。
evals.expected_output: Agent previews the week, reuses/creates the report, reads both variants' source drafts, shows two complete final drafts (technical template structure, plan section as a concise plain list with no item cap), and asks for approval. No save happens because no approval was given: both variants' finalStatus remain 'none' in the app.

evals.name: plan-section-follows-template
evals.prompt: 该写这周的周报了（2026-09-14 到 2026-09-20），先只要领导版。上周的终版你可以参考一下，但不是事实来源。写完给我过目再存。
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the week's leadership source draft, treats the previous week's (2026-09-07..13) current leadership final as optional reference rather than fact, and writes a 下周计划 section as a concise plain-text list when the chosen template includes it (no item cap). It presents the full draft for approval; if it consulted last week's final it also lists what it carried and dropped with one-line reasons. No save without approval.

evals.name: empty-draft-guard
evals.prompt: 帮我把 2026-08-03 到 2026-08-09 那周的周报写了，两个版本。
evals.expected_output: Preview shows an empty source draft; agent refuses to author a final, explains the week has no events (likely missing collect-source sync or wrong dates), and does not create a fabricated report or save anything.
